map.LTV（用户生命周期价值）估算 使用指南: LTV (user lifetime value) estimation user guide
map.输入 ARPU、流失率、毛利率和 CAC，计算用户生命周期价值(LTV)、LTV: Input ARPU, churn rate, gross margin and CAC to compute user lifetime value (LTV), LTV:CAC ratio and payback cycle, with sensitivity analysis and industry-benchmark comparison.
map.SaaS/订阅业务按 ARPU、毛利率与月流失率，估算单个用户生命周期价值 LT: SaaS/subscription businesses estimate a single user's lifetime value LTV from ARPU, gross margin and monthly churn rate, to judge business health.
map.结合 CAC 获客成本，算 LTV/CAC 与回收周期，评估买量是否划算。: Combined with CAC acquisition cost, compute LTV/CAC and payback cycle to assess whether buying traffic pays.
map.对流失率做敏感性分析，看留存改善能带来多少 LTV 提升。: Do sensitivity analysis on churn rate to see how much retention improvement boosts LTV.
map.：ARPU 50 元/月、毛利率 60%、月流失率 5%。LTV = ARPU×: : ARPU 50 yuan/month, gross margin 60%, monthly churn 5%. LTV = ARPU x gross margin / churn = 50 x 0.6 / 0.05 = 600 yuan; CAC 200 yuan, then LTV/CAC = 3.0 (healthy line usually >=3), payback = CAC / (ARPU x gross margin) = 200/30 approx 6.7 months.
map.用同口径的期间流失用户÷期初用户。注意'月流失 5%'意味着平均生命周期约 20: Use same-caliber period churned users / beginning users. Note "monthly churn 5%" means average life about 20 months (1/5%). Definitions differ greatly across businesses; align caliber with finance/growth teams before plugging in.
map.常见经验是 LTV/CAC ≥ 3 且回收期 ≤ 12 个月较健康，但重决策、长: Common experience: LTV/CAC >= 3 and payback <= 12 months is healthy, but heavy-decision and long-cycle businesses may relax. This ratio is highly sensitive to churn-rate assumptions; suggest interval estimation rather than a single point.
